title: Plural subject-pronoun use
focus: Learn when a olla sentence can omit a subject pronoun and when it should remain explicit.

exercises.prompt: Which shorter sentence still means “You are there”? Address more than one person; omit te.
exercises.explanation: Te can be omitted here because the ending in olette already identifies the subject in Finnish.

Correct. Te can be omitted here because the ending in olette already identifies the subject in Finnish.
“Te olette siellä.” does not fit this subject or construction. Te can be omitted here because the ending in olette already identifies the subject in Finnish.
